name: Fellwar Stone
oracle_text: {T}: Add one mana of any color that a land an opponent controls could produce.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Add one mana of any color that a land an opponent controls could produce.

needs.what: A mana ability whose set of choosable colors is computed at activation from what lands an opponent currently controls could produce (e.g. only G and U in a board where the opponent controls only a Forest and an Island among lands), rather than a fixed list of modes.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: A mana ability may contain only add_mana, or one choose_mode whose modes each contain only add_mana -- and choose_mode's modes are a static, author-time list, not something computed from the board at activation. There is no value_key or selector that reads what colors of mana an opponent's lands could produce (commander_color_identity is the closest color-set value_key, but it is a fixed deck property known outside the game state, not a dynamic read of opponents' lands). Authoring this as choose_mode over all five colors (the free-tier starting point) would let the ability produce colors the opponent has no land for, which is not what the card does.
